title: NIST WebBook: Water critical density
summary: The WebBook lists 4 critical density row(s) for Water. Reviewed rows and experimental rows are both quoted.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook critical density rows for Water (CAS 7732-18-5) print: 17.9 mol/l, method N/A, reference Sato, Watanabe, et al., 1991, comment: Uncertainty assigned by TRC = 0.2 mol/l; TRC (experimental or compiled row) | 17.91 mol/l, method N/A, reference Morita, Sato, et al., 1989, comment: Uncertainty assigned by TRC = 0.083 mol/l; based on analysis of obs. PVT and vapor pressure data; TRC (experimental or compiled row) | 17.9 mol/l, method N/A, reference Aleksandrov, 1986, comment: Uncertainty assigned by TRC = 0.2 mol/l; TRC (experimental or compiled row) | 17.9 mol/l, method N/A, reference Sifner, 1985, comment: Uncertainty assigned by TRC = 0.2 mol/l; TRC (experimental or compiled row). The page mixes reviewed or averaged rows with rows tied to a named experiment or compilation. A Review or AVG method is an evaluation. A Ccb method is combustion calorimetry, as the WebBook method code is linked. This card does not average the rows into a new number.
